Tehran really miscalculated…


Annmarie Hordern (@annmarie)

AP: Officials from Saudi Arabia, UAE, Kuwait and Bahrain have conveyed in private conversations that they do not want the military operation to end until there are significant changes in the Iranian leadership or there’s a dramatic shift in Iranian behavior, according to US, Gulf and Israeli officials.



— https://nitter.net/annmarie/status/2038911106362618219#m

Fun story about Kalleh Dairy: In the early 2000s they rolled out blue cheese, which my late mother loved. 

One time while checking out at a Tehran supermarket, the cashier warned her, “This cheese is rotten.” 

Maman didn’t miss a beat: “It’s fine, I’ll take the rotten cheese!”

An elderly protester from the anti-regime uprising in January was killed in an airstrike during the war 💔


Iranhrdc.org (@IHRDC)

Mohammadreza Javedan, a 79-year-old resident of Tehran, was killed in recent airstrikes after a bomb struck a residential area. The attack reportedly hit a civilian neighborhood, resulting in the death of the elderly civilian.

According to available information, Javedan had previously taken part in the January 2026 protests. Despite his age, he joined demonstrations

I call that medium pressure, not maximum pressure…


Gregg Carlstrom (@glcarlstrom)

The art of the deal: "As its tankers keep plying the strait, Iran is now earning nearly twice as much from oil sales each day as it did before American and Israeli bombs started falling on February 28th." economist.com/finance-and-ec…




— https://nitter.net/glcarlstrom/status/2038494843060498569#m

The pain of being Iranian during this war… 💔


Ali Noorani (@ali_noorani_teh)

It's been a month since Iran regime cut off internet and inbound phone access. I have missed my family so much.
Today, I received a DM from a woman saying she was my sister's friend. My sis had asked her to send me some family photos. I opened the photos and burst into tears.



— https://nitter.net/ali_noorani_teh/status/2038650949766431111#m
